screening_decisions.reason: This study examines bias from unpublished rating scales in schizophrenia trials. It does not involve benzodiazepines or tardive dyskinesia treatment. The study is a methodological analysis of 300 trials, not an RCT of benzodiazepines for TD.

This is a systematic review comparing TD risk between first and second-generation antipsychotics. It does not evaluate benzodiazepines as a treatment for TD. The intervention is antipsychotic medication, not benzodiazepines.

This study examines haloperidol serum concentrations and therapeutic response in schizophrenia. It does not involve benzodiazepines or TD treatment. The focus is on pharmacokinetics of haloperidol, not benzodiazepine intervention for TD.

This is an animal study (Cebus apella monkeys) examining GABA synthesis changes in neuroleptic-induced dyskinesia. It is not an RCT in humans, does not test benzodiazepines, and is mechanistic rather than therapeutic.

This study tests diazepam (a benzodiazepine) for treatment of tardive dyskinesia in 13 subjects with TD from antipsychotic use. It uses a 24-week crossover design with blind raters assessing TD using AIM Scale and BPRS. This meets all selection criteria: RCT design, benzodiazepine intervention, TD population with antipsychotic-induced TD.

This is a review article updating TD rates with first vs second-generation antipsychotics. It does not evaluate benzodiazepines as treatment for TD. The focus is on antipsychotic comparison, not benzodiazepine intervention.

This is a review article about EPS with atypical antipsychotics. While it mentions TD, it does not evaluate benzodiazepines as treatment. The focus is on antipsychotic therapy and EPS management, not benzodiazepine intervention for TD.
This study links BPRS scores to CGI ratings in schizophrenia trials. It does not involve benzodiazepines or TD treatment. The focus is on rating scale interpretation, not benzodiazepine intervention.

This is a review about benzodiazepine education and clinical use in psychiatry. While it mentions benzodiazepines, it does not evaluate them as treatment for TD. It is an educational/overview article, not an RCT of benzodiazepines for TD.

This is a review of TD incidence studies with typical antipsychotics. It does not evaluate benzodiazepines as treatment for TD. The focus is on TD incidence and risk factors, not benzodiazepine intervention.
This is a statistical methodology article about cluster randomization. It does not involve benzodiazepines, TD, or schizophrenia treatment. It is purely methodological.

This is an observational study examining TD improvement after neuroleptic discontinuation. It does not test benzodiazepines as treatment. The intervention is medication discontinuation, not benzodiazepine administration.
This is a methodological article about efficacy indices in therapy evaluation. It does not involve benzodiazepines, TD, or schizophrenia treatment. It is purely statistical/methodological.
This is a description of the BPRS rating scale. It does not involve benzodiazepines or TD treatment. It is about assessment methodology, not benzodiazepine intervention.

This article discusses antipsychotics and drug-induced movement disorders. While it mentions TD, it does not evaluate benzodiazepines as treatment. The focus is on antipsychotic therapy and discontinuation syndromes, not benzodiazepine intervention for TD.

This is a review about benzodiazepine abuse and dependence. While it mentions benzodiazepines, it does not evaluate them as treatment for TD. The focus is on addiction/dependence issues, not benzodiazepine intervention for TD.

This is a Cochrane review about non-benzodiazepine GABA agonists (baclofen, progabide, sodium valproate, THIP) for TD. The selection criteria explicitly states 'non-benzodiazepine GABA agonist drugs' - this review specifically excludes benzodiazepines. It does not meet the benzodiazepine intervention criterion.
This is a statistical methodology article about detecting skewness in data. It does not involve benzodiazepines, TD, or schizophrenia treatment. It is purely methodological.

This is a general article about clinical research for schizophrenia treatment. It does not involve benzodiazepines or TD treatment. The focus is on broader issues of psychiatric research and policy, not benzodiazepine intervention for TD.

This is a Cochrane review about calcium channel blockers (diltiazem, nifedipine, nimodipine, verapamil) for TD. It does not evaluate benzodiazepines as treatment. The intervention is calcium channel blockers, not benzodiazepines.
This study focuses on interpreting PANSS scores in schizophrenia patients, not on benzodiazepine treatment for tardive dyskinesia. No benzodiazepine intervention is tested.
This is a systematic review/meta-analysis comparing TD risk between antipsychotic types, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
This study compares haloperidol dosing regimens in acute schizophrenia, not benzodiazepine treatment for tardive dyskinesia.

This study compares two benzodiazepines (diazepam vs nitrazepam) for treating postneuroleptic TD in 20 patients. While it compares two benzodiazepines rather than benzodiazepine vs placebo, it tests benzodiazepines for TD treatment and could provide comparative efficacy data.
This controlled study tests clonazepam (benzodiazepine) versus phenobarbital (active placebo) in 21 psychiatric patients with TD. Meets criteria as it tests benzodiazepine for TD treatment.

This study tests diazepam (benzodiazepine) among other agents for TD treatment in 14 patients with TD. While it's a single-dose study and tests multiple agents, it includes benzodiazepine intervention for TD.
This is about Vitamin E treatment for TD, not benzodiazepines. Does not meet the intervention criteria.
This is an observational cohort study examining mortality rates in TD patients, not an RCT testing benzodiazepine treatment for TD.
This is a Cochrane review about cholinergic drugs for TD, not benzodiazepines. Does not meet the intervention criteria.
This is about catecholaminergic drugs for TD, not benzodiazepines. Does not meet the intervention criteria.
This study tests tetrabenazine with diazepam as control. The primary intervention is tetrabenazine, not benzodiazepines. Benzodiazepine is used as comparator, not the intervention of interest.
Despite the title, the abstract describes an animal study (rats) about GVHD and Purkinje cells, not a human RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD treatment.

This RCT tests naltrexone alone and naltrexone combined with clonazepam (benzodiazepine) for TD in schizophrenia patients. While primarily about naltrexone, it includes clonazepam as part of the intervention and provides data on benzodiazepine use in TD treatment.
This is an observational naturalistic study comparing outcomes in patients with vs without TD, not an RCT testing benzodiazepine treatment.
This is a review article discussing various TD treatment options, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
This is a 12-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized crossover trial testing clonazepam (benzodiazepine) in 19 patients with TD. Clearly meets all selection criteria.
This study tests diazepam (benzodiazepine) for TD treatment in 21 patients using an ABA' design. While not a traditional RCT, it tests benzodiazepine intervention for TD and provides treatment data.
This is a methodological paper about detecting bias in meta-analyses, not about benzodiazepine treatment for TD.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis issues, not about benzodiazepine treatment for TD.
This is a review article about TD pathophysiology and treatment principles, not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Methodological paper, not an RCT on benzodiazepines for TD
Wrong condition (akathisia, not TD) and wrong intervention (benztropine/propranolol, not benzodiazepines)
Methodological paper about meta-analysis
Investigates diazepam (benzodiazepine) for TD; ABA design noted but including conservatively for full-text review
Survey methodology paper, unrelated to TD treatment
Methodological paper about RCT reporting quality
Compares antipsychotics (olanzapine vs haloperidol), not benzodiazepines for TD treatment
Methodological paper about attrition in RCTs
Systematic review of cluster intervention methods
Theoretical/review paper on TD pathophysiology
Methodological paper about trial quality assessment
Methodological paper about statistical errors
Methodological paper about meta-analysis techniques
Observational longitudinal study, not an RCT, no benzodiazepine intervention
